svg.text: apply - the slice handed to the function
concat - the dimension objects are joined along
drop - the label removed from that axis
the column labelled col_a is gone
For reductions, axis=n identifies the dimension being collapsed
Outside explicit reductions, axis selects the dimension the operation acts on -
whether the shape changes depends on the operation
For a 3D reduction: axis=0 collapses layers, axis=1 rows within each layer, axis=2 columns
drop takes labels, not positions - df.drop(0) fails if no row is labelled 0
